title: Elevate UI Headings: Master 'text-wrap: balance' for Perfect Line Breaks
tweet: Boost your UI design with 'text-wrap: balance'! ✨ Say goodbye to awkward heading line breaks and hello to perfectly balanced text, improving readability & UX. #CSSTypography #UIDesign #WebFonts #UserExperience
tip: Achieve visually harmonious and readable headings by leveraging the CSS 'text-wrap: balance' property. This experimental yet powerful feature intelligently distributes words across lines to minimize visual imbalance, making your headlines easier to scan and more aesthetically pleasing. It's particularly effective for short blocks of text like titles and captions, significantly enhancing the overall user experience and polish of your UI.
